title: Target anchorable links
description: A non-empty array with one entry per (activity, definition) pair, each linking a target anchorable definition file to a target property of an activity in a XAML workflow.

workflowFilePath.description: Absolute path of the .xaml workflow inside the project directory, with forward slashes (a backslash is a JSON escape). A relative path resolves against the CLI working directory, not --project-dir.

activityId.description: The activity's sap2010:WorkflowViewState.IdRef in the workflow (for example 'NClick_3').

definitionFilePath.description: Absolute path of the target anchorable definition file to link, with forward slashes (a backslash is a JSON escape). A relative path resolves against the CLI working directory, not --project-dir.

targetProperty.description: Activity property that receives the target. Dotted paths address nested properties (for example 'SearchedElement.Target'). Omitted or empty means 'Target'.
